The evidence is enough for the verdict, but the probe should report this ability's state as it does for the menu abilities.

Locked water-bucket excerpts contain no positive server-side denial marker (no cancelled=true, no ATD_CRITERION_SUPPRESSED, no DENIAL_INTENT line); the denial is shown only by the absence of the effect (water probe stays 'Test failed') plus the client overlay. The verdict can be reproduced from this, but a guard log line would make the proof direct.
